name: Gail Symons
residence: Eight miles east of Sheridan, Sheridan County, adjacent to the Symons family ranch (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
occupation: Retired U.S. Navy Supply Corps officer and retired General Electric professional; community and civic work in Sheridan after moving back full time in 2016 (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
education: B.S. in marketing, University of Wyoming; M.B.A. in organizational management, University of Hawaii (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
military: U.S. Navy Supply Corps, including shipboard tours and assignments in retail, finance, auditing, and program management (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
background: In her 2024 WyoFile questionnaire, Gail Symons wrote that she lived in the house she purchased from her parents 14 years earlier, adjacent to the Symons family ranch eight miles east of Sheridan, and that the family is in its fourth and fifth generation of Wyoming agriculture, with a land patent predating statehood. She wrote that she was born and raised in Sheridan, would be 68 on Election Day 2024, and had been a registered Sheridan County Republican voter for 50 years.

She wrote that she earned a B.S. in marketing at the University of Wyoming, then joined the U.S. Navy Supply Corps, with shipboard tours and assignments in retail, finance, auditing, and program management, and concurrently earned an M.B.A. in organizational management at the University of Hawaii. After retiring from the Navy she joined General Electric in its Six Sigma program and later worked in marketing and supply chain. In 2016 she retired again and moved back to Sheridan full time. She wrote that she created Civics307.com to track legislation and established WY Vote (wyvote.vote) to help inform voters.
